verdict.rationale: Firstbase markets managed compliance and a compliance dashboard where users can view deadlines and take actions, but nothing shows an AI agent can prepare or file an annual report through the platform. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, so there is no evidence of programmatic or agent access. The managed-service claims describe Firstbase staff or the dashboard doing the work, not agent delegation, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
